env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A comptime generic is cut at its own tokens: the func keyword, the name
# and the type parameter list are found by position, so a block comment,
# a line comment or a line break in any gap of the header changes
# nothing, for a function that is instantiated, one that nothing
# instantiates, one that another package instantiates, and one that
# calls a second generic from inside a const for. The same holds for the
# types and constants that an exported const function of another
# package needs: the keyword of each declaration is found by its tokens,
# whatever comment or line break stands between it and the name. The
# module runs natively, ejects without the dropped functions, and the
# ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^\[A B\] \[A B\] \[A B\] \[X Y\] \[A B\] \[X Y\]$'
stdout '^\[A B\] \[X Y\] \[X Y\] \[Ak Bk\]$'
stdout '^\[A B\] \[A B\] \[A B\] \[X Y\] \[A B\] \[X Y\]$'
stdout '^\[X Y\] \[A B\] \[Xk Yk\]$'
stdout '^81$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/lib/lib.go
! grep 'unused' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/lib/lib.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/comptimetparamboundary

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/comptimetparamboundary/lib"
)

type S struct {
	A int
	B string
}

type P struct{ X, Y int }

func /*c*/ Block[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

	return "k"

func Gap[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const /*c*/ for /*d*/ _ /*e*/ , /*f*/ f /*g*/ := /*h*/ range /*i*/ comptime.Fields /*j*/ [ /*k*/ T /*l*/ ] /*m*/ ( /*n*/ ) /*o*/ {
		out = append(out, f.Name+kind /*p*/ [ /*q*/ T /*r*/ ] /*s*/ ( /*t*/ ))
	}
	return out
}

const norm = lib.Norm(3)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Block[S](), Line[S](), Break[S](), Name[P](), Open[S](), Close[P]())
	fmt.Println(Multi[S, []int](), Both[P, S](), priv[P](), Gap[S]())
	fmt.Println(lib.Block[S](), lib.Line[S](), lib.Break[S](), lib.Name[P](), lib.Open[S](), lib.Close[P]())
	fmt.Println(lib.Multi[P, [4]int](), lib.Both[S, P](), lib.Gap[P]())
	fmt.Println(norm)
}

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

func /*c*/ Block[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func // c
Line[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func
Break[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func Name /*c*/ [T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func Open[ /*c*/ T /*d*/ any /*e*/ ]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func Close[T any] /*c*/ () []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func Multi[T /* ] */ any, U interface{ ~[]int | ~[4]int }]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func /*c*/ /*d*/ Both /*e*/ [ // f
	T any,
	// g
	U any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func /*c*/ Kind /*d*/ [ /*e*/ T any] /*f*/ () string {
	_ = comptime.TypeOf[T]()
	return "k"
}

func Gap[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const /*c*/ for /*d*/ _ /*e*/ , /*f*/ f /*g*/ := /*h*/ range /*i*/ comptime.Fields /*j*/ [ /*k*/ T /*l*/ ] /*m*/ ( /*n*/ ) /*o*/ {
		out = append(out, f.Name+Kind /*p*/ [ /*q*/ T /*r*/ ] /*s*/ ( /*t*/ ))
	}
	return out
}

type // c
Point struct{ X, Y int }

const /*c*/ // d
Scale = 3

const ( // c
	Bias = 1
)

type ( // c
	Cell struct{ V int }
)

func /*c*/ // d
helper(x int) int { return x + Bias }

const func Norm(x int) int {
	p := Point{X: x, Y: 4}
	c := Cell{V: Bias}
	return helper(p.X*p.X+p.Y*p.Y+c.V) * Scale
}
